name: Dagna Flintmark
source_profile: ● Dagna Flintmark (CG) is a young prospector and accomplished spelunker who has become increasingly frustrated with the Claimholders' cautious leadership. She believes the dwarves should reopen their ancestral mines regardless of Cadorian permission and has organized several unauthorized expeditions into abandoned mountain passages.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 76 (source excerpt; may be partial)
